notes: IBM Granite 4.2 mid-size instruct model (Aug 2026), Apache 2.0. Dense 8.8B with 131K context. Ollama pull about 5 GB, comfortable on 8GB machines. Tag registry-verified.

name: Granite 4.2 30B
notes: IBM Granite 4.2 flagship dense model (Aug 2026), Apache 2.0. 29B with 131K context. The :30b pull is listed at 18GB on the Ollama library page, so it wants a 24GB machine. Tag registry-verified.

name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
notes: NVIDIA hybrid Mamba-MoE (Aug 2026): 30B total with 3B active, 52 layers of which only 6 are full attention (2 KV heads), so KV-cache is a fraction of a dense 30B and context scales to 1M tokens. NVFP4 official build; the Ollama :30b pull is about 24 GB and wants a 36GB machine. Tag registry-verified.

name: Muse Glimmer 30B
notes: Community 30B general chat model (Aug 2026, meta-models org on Hugging Face). Limited public evaluation data; treat quality as unverified. Ollama pull about 17 GB, fits a 24GB machine. Tag registry-verified.

name: MiniCPM-V 4.5 8B
notes: OpenBMB vision-language model (Aug 2025), Apache 2.0: 8.7B with image understanding, a strong local pick for screenshots and document parsing. Ollama pull about 6 GB. Tag registry-verified.

name: GLM-5.3
notes: Z.ai flagship refresh (Aug 25, 2026), 753B total MoE with 1M context, MIT weights on Hugging Face. Successor to GLM-5.2 for Claude Code / OpenCode-style agentic use via API. Far beyond consumer hardware locally.

name: GLM-5.3 Flash
notes: Z.ai fast tier (Aug 25, 2026), 321B total MoE, MIT weights on Hugging Face. Cheap hosted workhorse; too large for consumer local hardware even at aggressive quants.

name: GLM-4.7-Flash 30B-A3B
notes: Z.ai's local-class GLM (Jan 2026, MIT). A 30B-A3B MoE with compressed multi-latent attention, so decode speed tracks the 3B active path. SWE-bench Verified 59.2 per the model card, well ahead of Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 in the same table. The Ollama default pull is Q4_K_M at about 19 GB, so a 32GB Mac runs it with room for context. Tag registry-verified.

name: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B
notes: NVIDIA's mid-size open model (March 11, 2026, NVIDIA Open Model License). 120B total with 12B active in a LatentMoE hybrid of Mamba-2, MoE and a few attention layers, plus Multi-Token Prediction. Context up to 1M tokens. The card reports MMLU-Pro 83.73 and SWE-Bench (OpenHands) 60.47. The Ollama :120b pull is Q4_K_M at about 87 GB, so it needs a 128GB machine. Tag registry-verified.

name: Olmo 3.1 32B Instruct
notes: Ai2's fully open 32B dense model (Apache 2.0): weights, data and training code are all public, which is the reason to pick it. On raw capability it trails Qwen 3 32B in no-think mode on MMLU (80.9 vs 85.8) and GPQA (48.6 vs 54.4) in Ai2's own table. The Ollama pull is Q4_K_M at about 19 GB. Tag registry-verified.

name: MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B
notes: Xiaomi's distillation of MiMo-V2.6 into Qwen3.5-9B (Sept 2026, MIT). Per the card, SWE Verified 61.1 vs 60.0 for the base Qwen3.5-9B and SWE Pro 44.6 vs 32.0. No Ollama library tag; run the GGUF through llama.cpp or LM Studio (bartowski Q4_K_M is about 6 GB, so a 16GB Mac runs it comfortably).

name: Ling-3.0-flash
notes: inclusionAI (Ant Group) hybrid-linear MoE, Aug 2026, MIT. Total 124B, activated 5.1B, with Kimi Delta Attention and MLA stacked 5:1, trained up to 256K context. A vision-language sibling, Ling-3.0-flash-VL, shares the backbone and gained llama.cpp support on Sept 24, 2026. No Ollama tag: the bartowski Q4_K_M GGUF is about 78 GB (128GB machine); IQ4_XS at about 69 GB squeezes onto 96GB.

name: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Flash
notes: Sept 21, 2026 Xiaomi release (MIT, XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL on HF), successor to MiMo-V2-Flash. Sparse MoE with 309B total / 15B activated parameters, native text, image, video and audio input, 1M tokens of context. No Ollama build; community GGUFs exist, so a ~Q4 build fits a 256GB-class machine via llama.cpp.

name: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro
notes: Sept 21, 2026 Xiaomi flagship (MIT, XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL on HF). Sparse MoE with 1.02T total / 42B activated parameters, omnimodal input and 1M tokens of context. Open weights, but beyond any consumer machine: API or a multi-GPU server.

name: Devstral Small 2 24B
notes: Mistral's 24B dense coding agent (late 2025, Apache 2.0) with a 256k context window and image input. SWE Bench Verified 68.0% per Mistral's card, level with GLM 4.6 at 355B in the same table. A coding specialist, so it is kept out of the general best-pick. The Ollama :24b pull is Q4_K_M at about 15 GB, which fits a 24GB Mac. Tag registry-verified.

name: Devstral 2 123B
notes: Mistral's flagship coding agent (late 2025, modified MIT license) with a 256k context window. SWE Bench Verified 72.2% per Mistral's card, above its 24B sibling Devstral Small 2. It is dense, so every token reads all 123B weights: expect slow decode even on a Max or Ultra. The Ollama :123b pull is Q4_K_M at about 75 GB, which needs a 96GB machine. Tag registry-verified.
